subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 2 – Graded readers: The New Shop & A Bowl of Soup
outcomes: Understand how the new shop changes from empty to popular.
Follow Grandad's soup recipe in the right order.
Find the problem in a story and how it is solved.

tf.s: At the start, the new shop is empty.
tf.why: Yes! Nobody knows about it yet.

tf.s: The new shop only has milkshakes.
Hamzah's cousins go to the new shop.
tf.why: Correct! They go to the new shop.

tf.s: At the end, the shop is still empty.
tf.why: At the end, the shop is popular.
Well done! Hamzah wants to try one.

tf.s: Huda and Muna find Grandad's book of recipes in the bookcase.
tf.why: Yes! The recipes are in the bookcase.

tf.s: There is a box of rice and a bag of noodles.
tf.why: There is a box of noodles and a bag of rice.

tf.s: The first step of the soup is to add vegetables.
tf.why: First, put the noodles in a pan.

tf.s: Grandad brings vegetables from his garden.
There aren't any vegetables in the soup at the end.
tf.why: Grandad brings lots of vegetables, so the soup has vegetables.

boxes.q: Why is the shop empty at the start?
boxes.why: Nobody knows about the new shop yet.

boxes.q: What does Hamzah want to try?

boxes.why: A popular shop has lots of people.

o: Can I have a milkshake, please?

boxes.q: Where is Grandad's book of recipes?
What do you add after the noodles?
What is the problem in 'A Bowl of Soup'?
boxes.why: Oh no! There aren't any vegetables!

boxes.q: What do you eat soup from?
boxes.why: We eat soup from a bowl.
You boil noodles in very hot water.

hunt.q: At the start, the shop is...
At the end, the shop is...

mcq.q: Whose book of recipes is it?
mcq.why: It is Grandad's book of recipes.

mcq.q: Who finds the book of recipes?
What is the first step of Grandad's soup?
o: Put the noodles in a pan.
mcq.why: First, put the noodles in a pan.

mcq.q: Which word means steps for cooking a dish?
mcq.why: A recipe tells you how to cook.

mcq.q: Customer: Can I have a milkshake, please? Shopkeeper: Sure. ...
mcq.why: The shopkeeper asks if you want more.

mcq.q: Choose the sentence that tells a friend about a good shop.
o: There's a new shop. The milkshakes are delicious!
The shop is empty and sad.
mcq.why: This sentence makes your friend want to visit.

mcq.q: Write two steps of the soup with sequence words.
o: First, put the noodles in a pan. Then, add a little water.
Then, put the noodles in a pan. First, add water.
Last, put the noodles in a pan. First, eat.
After that, eat. First, boil the bowl.
mcq.why: First and Then show the right order.

mcq.q: How does the shop become popular?
o: Hamzah tells his cousins, they tell friends, and friends tell all their friends.
The shop gives free food to everyone.
The shop closes for a week.
mcq.why: The news spreads from person to person.

mcq.q: How is the problem in 'A Bowl of Soup' solved?
o: Grandad brings lots of vegetables from his garden.
They put rice in a bottle.
mcq.why: Grandad's garden vegetables save the soup.

mcq.q: What is the same in both stories?
o: Both are about a football game.
mcq.why: One story has milkshakes and one has soup.
